doc.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Joe Williams joins Gerald's band, St. Louis and Ella Fitzgerald
summary: Gerald hired Joe Williams at the El Grotto and took him to the Club Riviera in St. Louis, battling Louis Armstrong and Ella Fitzgerald.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: Yes, at the El Grotto I didn’t have a singer. So my male singer, he had to go away, he had to leave. So he said well what are you going to do? The guy that owned the club was Harry Fields. He said, “Listen, there’s a guy here named Joe Williams.” I said, “Well I know Joe Williams,” he used to sing. Well I didn’t know him personally, but I’d heard him sing with Lionel Hampton’s band and so I knew he was a fine singer. So he said, “We can get Joe Williams.” So he got Joe Williams for us. Joe came in and finished the two weeks at the El Grotto, then we went directly from the El Grotto to the Club Riviera in St. Louis, where Ella Fitzgerald was the top draw, and it was my band, and I had Joe singing with my band. That was a six week engagement, and we were doing great. Joe was singing, he could sing all the numbers we had. He was a fine singer then, and he could sing the same numbers as the guy—

Yeah, he could sing all those numbers of that guy, Dick Gray, was singing. So we had Joe with us, and Joe loved it, of course being there with Ella Fitzgerald. I remember we battled, our band and Joe, we battled Louis Armstrong’s band and Ella Fitzgerald. And you know it was like this all night long.
